# Coca-Cola and PepsiCo Revenue and Net Income Investigation for 2023 and 2024

**Mixed**

Coca-Cola and PepsiCo both expanded annual revenue across 2023 and 2024 [E10adbabd51](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134424000009/0000021344-24-000009-index.html) [E07afbadf50](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134425000011/0000021344-25-000011-index.html) [E6fd2f1745f](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/77476/000007747624000008/0000077476-24-000008-index.html) [E3a01f78c7b](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/77476/000007747625000007/0000077476-25-000007-index.html). Coca-Cola experienced net income growth in 2023 but a decrease in 2024 [E0fb9fe3820](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134424000009/0000021344-24-000009-index.html) [Ec26e1da10b](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134425000011/0000021344-25-000011-index.html), while PepsiCo increased net income in both years [Eaa27cd067c](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/77476/000007747624000008/0000077476-24-000008-index.html) [Ea9c3b3e85e](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/77476/000007747625000007/0000077476-25-000007-index.html). Coca-Cola's capital expenditure outlook of approximately $1.9 billion for 2023 [Ea1bd0fa549](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134423000011/ko-20221231.htm) was supported by actual reported PP&E additions of $1.852 billion [E2baac9960b](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134424000009/0000021344-24-000009-index.html). PepsiCo's shareholder return outlook [Eecf366ae6f](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/77476/000007747623000007/pep-20221231.htm) lacks a direct comparable cash metric in the retrieved XBRL set and is marked not testable.

## Numbers on record

KO revenue for the fiscal period ended 2024-12-31 was $47.061 billion [E07afbadf50](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134425000011/0000021344-25-000011-index.html), up from $45.754 billion for 2023-12-31 [E10adbabd51](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134424000009/0000021344-24-000009-index.html). KO net income for the fiscal period ended 2024-12-31 was $10.631 billion [Ec26e1da10b](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134425000011/0000021344-25-000011-index.html), down from $10.714 billion for 2023-12-31 [E0fb9fe3820](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134424000009/0000021344-24-000009-index.html). KO cash PP&E purchases for the fiscal period ended 2024-12-31 was $2.064 billion [Ea152b96155](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134425000011/0000021344-25-000011-index.html), up from $1.852 billion for 2023-12-31 [E2baac9960b](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134424000009/0000021344-24-000009-index.html).

## What was knowable then

As of the March 1, 2023 as-of date, annual financial results through fiscal 2022 were fully reported for both Coca-Cola and PepsiCo. Coca-Cola reported revenues of $33,014,000,000 for 2020 [Eb47c706fac](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134421000008/0000021344-21-000008-index.html), $38,655,000,000 for 2021 [E5dea48f7cf](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134422000009/0000021344-22-000009-index.html), and $43,004,000,000 for 2022 [E4fe3fd5477](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134423000011/0000021344-23-000011-index.html), alongside net income figures of $7,747,000,000 [E7bbed54385](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134421000008/0000021344-21-000008-index.html), $9,771,000,000 [E52fb7d36c6](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134422000009/0000021344-22-000009-index.html), and $9,542,000,000 [E1e273790bd](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134423000011/0000021344-23-000011-index.html) respectively. PepsiCo reported revenues of $70,372,000,000 for fiscal 2020 [E3ebbadddd6](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/77476/000007747621000007/0000077476-21-000007-index.html), $79,474,000,000 for fiscal 2021 [E01a7c87a32](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/77476/000007747622000010/0000077476-22-000010-index.html), and $86,392,000,000 for fiscal 2022 [Ea540fdd32b](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/77476/000007747623000007/0000077476-23-000007-index.html), alongside net income of $7,120,000,000 [Eec9947e383](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/77476/000007747621000007/0000077476-21-000007-index.html), $7,618,000,000 [Edf76ba522e](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/77476/000007747622000010/0000077476-22-000010-index.html), and $8,910,000,000 [Ecfe5e45f6b](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/77476/000007747623000007/0000077476-23-000007-index.html) respectively. Management outlook statements filed by Coca-Cola indicated an expectation for 2023 capital expenditures of approximately $1.9 billion [Ea1bd0fa549](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134423000011/ko-20221231.htm), while PepsiCo outlined plans to return approximately $7.7 billion to shareholders in 2023 [Eecf366ae6f](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/77476/000007747623000007/pep-20221231.htm).

## What happened later

Subsequent filings revealed top-line growth for both entities across 2023 and 2024. Coca-Cola reported 2023 revenue of $45,754,000,000 and net income of $10,714,000,000 [E10adbabd51](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134424000009/0000021344-24-000009-index.html) [E0fb9fe3820](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134424000009/0000021344-24-000009-index.html), followed by 2024 revenue of $47,061,000,000 and net income of $10,631,000,000 [E07afbadf50](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134425000011/0000021344-25-000011-index.html) [Ec26e1da10b](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134425000011/0000021344-25-000011-index.html). Coca-Cola's actual 2023 capital expenditures were $1,852,000,000 [E2baac9960b](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134424000009/0000021344-24-000009-index.html), and 2024 capital expenditures reached $2,064,000,000 [Ea152b96155](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134425000011/0000021344-25-000011-index.html). PepsiCo reported fiscal 2023 revenue of $91,471,000,000 and net income of $9,074,000,000 for the period ending 2023-12-30 [E6fd2f1745f](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/77476/000007747624000008/0000077476-24-000008-index.html) [Eaa27cd067c](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/77476/000007747624000008/0000077476-24-000008-index.html), and fiscal 2024 revenue of $91,854,000,000 and net income of $9,578,000,000 for the period ending 2024-12-28 [E3a01f78c7b](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/77476/000007747625000007/0000077476-25-000007-index.html) [Ea9c3b3e85e](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/77476/000007747625000007/0000077476-25-000007-index.html).

## The peer test

Comparing annual performance for fiscal 2023 and 2024, PepsiCo maintained a larger scale in total reported revenue ($91,471,000,000 for the period ending 2023-12-30 [E6fd2f1745f](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/77476/000007747624000008/0000077476-24-000008-index.html) and $91,854,000,000 for the period ending 2024-12-28 [E3a01f78c7b](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/77476/000007747625000007/0000077476-25-000007-index.html)) compared to Coca-Cola ($45,754,000,000 for the period ending 2023-12-31 [E10adbabd51](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134424000009/0000021344-24-000009-index.html) and $47,061,000,000 for the period ending 2024-12-31 [E07afbadf50](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134425000011/0000021344-25-000011-index.html)). Net income totals for 2023 were $10,714,000,000 for Coca-Cola [E0fb9fe3820](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134424000009/0000021344-24-000009-index.html) and $9,074,000,000 for PepsiCo [Eaa27cd067c](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/77476/000007747624000008/0000077476-24-000008-index.html), while 2024 net income totals were $10,631,000,000 for Coca-Cola [Ec26e1da10b](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134425000011/0000021344-25-000011-index.html) and $9,578,000,000 for PepsiCo [Ea9c3b3e85e](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/77476/000007747625000007/0000077476-25-000007-index.html). The companies utilize different fiscal calendars, with PepsiCo ending its fiscal year on the last Saturday of December and Coca-Cola concluding on December 31. Free cash flow and capital expenditure peer comparisons are incomplete because supported annual USD capex tags for PepsiCo were not retrieved [Ecd5a7a34b2].

## Cross-examination

Coca-Cola's statement expecting 2023 capital expenditures of approximately $1.9 billion [Ea1bd0fa549](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134423000011/ko-20221231.htm) is a verifiable numeric forecast, which was supported by the actual reported 2023 PP&E cash addition of $1.852 billion [E2baac9960b](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134424000009/0000021344-24-000009-index.html). Conversely, PepsiCo's shareholder return projection of $7.7 billion [Eecf366ae6f](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/77476/000007747623000007/pep-20221231.htm) and emerging market risk commentary [E44b7e131a2](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/77476/000007747623000007/pep-20221231.htm) lack direct entity-wide financial line items or segment metrics in the supported XBRL set, rendering them not testable. Company-wide financial metrics must not be conflated with localized product or geographic targets, which were absent from the general guidance scope.

## Limits

- As-of vintage macroeconomic data prior to March 1, 2023 is excluded from the hindsight context.
- No annual USD capex observation was retrieved for PepsiCo under supported XBRL tags, leaving free cash flow and capital expenditure peer comparisons incomplete.

sections.title: What was knowable then
sections.text: As of the March 1, 2023 as-of date, annual financial results through fiscal 2022 were fully reported for both Coca-Cola and PepsiCo. Coca-Cola reported revenues of $33,014,000,000 for 2020 [Eb47c706fac], $38,655,000,000 for 2021 [E5dea48f7cf], and $43,004,000,000 for 2022 [E4fe3fd5477], alongside net income figures of $7,747,000,000 [E7bbed54385], $9,771,000,000 [E52fb7d36c6], and $9,542,000,000 [E1e273790bd] respectively. PepsiCo reported revenues of $70,372,000,000 for fiscal 2020 [E3ebbadddd6], $79,474,000,000 for fiscal 2021 [E01a7c87a32], and $86,392,000,000 for fiscal 2022 [Ea540fdd32b], alongside net income of $7,120,000,000 [Eec9947e383], $7,618,000,000 [Edf76ba522e], and $8,910,000,000 [Ecfe5e45f6b] respectively. Management outlook statements filed by Coca-Cola indicated an expectation for 2023 capital expenditures of approximately $1.9 billion [Ea1bd0fa549], while PepsiCo outlined plans to return approximately $7.7 billion to shareholders in 2023 [Eecf366ae6f].

sections.title: What happened later
sections.text: Subsequent filings revealed top-line growth for both entities across 2023 and 2024. Coca-Cola reported 2023 revenue of $45,754,000,000 and net income of $10,714,000,000 [E10adbabd51] [E0fb9fe3820], followed by 2024 revenue of $47,061,000,000 and net income of $10,631,000,000 [E07afbadf50] [Ec26e1da10b]. Coca-Cola's actual 2023 capital expenditures were $1,852,000,000 [E2baac9960b], and 2024 capital expenditures reached $2,064,000,000 [Ea152b96155]. PepsiCo reported fiscal 2023 revenue of $91,471,000,000 and net income of $9,074,000,000 for the period ending 2023-12-30 [E6fd2f1745f] [Eaa27cd067c], and fiscal 2024 revenue of $91,854,000,000 and net income of $9,578,000,000 for the period ending 2024-12-28 [E3a01f78c7b] [Ea9c3b3e85e].

sections.title: The peer test
sections.text: Comparing annual performance for fiscal 2023 and 2024, PepsiCo maintained a larger scale in total reported revenue ($91,471,000,000 for the period ending 2023-12-30 [E6fd2f1745f] and $91,854,000,000 for the period ending 2024-12-28 [E3a01f78c7b]) compared to Coca-Cola ($45,754,000,000 for the period ending 2023-12-31 [E10adbabd51] and $47,061,000,000 for the period ending 2024-12-31 [E07afbadf50]). Net income totals for 2023 were $10,714,000,000 for Coca-Cola [E0fb9fe3820] and $9,074,000,000 for PepsiCo [Eaa27cd067c], while 2024 net income totals were $10,631,000,000 for Coca-Cola [Ec26e1da10b] and $9,578,000,000 for PepsiCo [Ea9c3b3e85e]. The companies utilize different fiscal calendars, with PepsiCo ending its fiscal year on the last Saturday of December and Coca-Cola concluding on December 31. Free cash flow and capital expenditure peer comparisons are incomplete because supported annual USD capex tags for PepsiCo were not retrieved [Ecd5a7a34b2].
